assets.title: Fifty US states and District of Columbia — prepared display geometry
assets.creator: U.S. Department of Commerce, U.S. Census Bureau, Geography Division
assets.modifications: Selected 50 states and DC; mapped longitude/latitude to a fixed display canvas; separately scaled/offset Alaska and Hawaii insets; quantized integer coordinates and simplified subpixel canvas segments; added an enlarged DC selection marker. Geometry is display-only, without geographic/business analysis.
assets.purpose: Offline domestic map with a complete list alternative
assets.credit_text: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 Cartographic Boundary Files, 1:5,000,000. Prepared and modified for game display; Alaska/Hawaii insets and an enlarged DC marker.

assets.title: World countries — offline display geometry
assets.creator: Natural Earth contributors
assets.modifications: Removed statistical attributes, retained 176 country outlines excluding Antarctica, quantized to integer hundredths of a degree and assigned broad fictional game regions. Display boundaries do not model historical border changes.
assets.purpose: Offline world map with a full country list alternative
assets.credit_text: Made with Natural Earth. Public domain. Prepared for game display.

assets.title: Employee portrait vector layers v1
assets.creator: VexStrips / future (selected Bitclone head and hair paths); Project Glowing Pancake (complementary procedural layers and palette)
assets.modifications: Selected 6 head and 8 rear-hair paths; normalized geometry; replaced palette and strokes; authored compatible facial features, front hair, necks and clothing. Removed editor metadata and effects.
assets.purpose: Offline scale-independent portraits generated at application time; versioned IDs persisted in profiles
assets.credit_text: Head and rear-hair shapes adapted from Bitclone Basic Face Kit 2 by VexStrips / future, Openclipart CC0. Complementary layers and palette by Project Glowing Pancake.

assets.title: Reference city in each state and DC, 2010 Census
assets.creator: U.S. Census Bureau
assets.modifications: Selected largest 2010 Census place per state/DC by population; retained original names/codes/counts and added four short display aliases.
assets.purpose: Offline reference city labels; no economic or geographic simulation is inferred from these labels.
assets.credit_text: City context: U.S. Census Bureau, 2010 National Places Gazetteer. Largest Census place in each state and DC; names shortened for display.
